mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may inhibit fexofenadine metabolism via CYP3A4, increasing fexofenadine levels and QT prolongation risk, while fexofenadine has minimal serotonergic activity reducing direct serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor QT interval and cardiac status; consider alternative antihistamine or ensure adequate washout period between drugs; baseline ECG recommended.
